methodology.ranking: Major Algerian national and private channels, ordered first by Kantar Africascope 2025 viewing evidence and then by current national carriage and public-service prominence
methodology.publication_rule: Exact live linear channel, three real audio/video decode passes, moving current programming, and cloud-hosted Apple-compatible delivery that does not depend on this Mac

latest_audit.source_rotation: Current official TV6/TV8/TV9, Samira TV, Echorouk TV, Echorouk News, El Hayat, and El Watania YouTube identities; TDA's current public/private roster; EPTV's current site and app; Samira TV's official site and Samira+ app/support surfaces; Echorouk's official signed live players; El Watania's first-party HLS; iptv-org Algeria; maintained public resolvers; and production cloud egress tests
latest_audit.published_regression: GitHub Actions run 30183067345 passed dynamic-feed handling, canonical/alias identity and ordering, all 36 independent local-playlist audio/video/moving-frame attempts, publication visibility, and all 36 public Apple-TV-path attempts. IPTVX force-reloaded the public playlist and displayed all 12 identities. That reload exposed an intermittent expired-wrapper black-screen failure for Almagharibia; production relay version 32 now rotates four official YouTube player endpoints and adds bounded independent cloud hops, passed a 30-request public burst without failure, and then sustained visibly changing current Almagharibia video in IPTVX for 20 seconds.
evidence: TDA's current official roster still confirms Samira TV, Echorouk TV, Echorouk News, El Hayat TV, and El Watania TV in the private HD/SD bouquet and TV6, TV8, and TV9 in the public bouquet; this preserves their high-priority target status but provides satellite parameters rather than IPTV delivery.

Echorouk TV and Echorouk News official player endpoints returned HTTP 403 in this fresh pass. Their current Molotov operator pages confirm both exact channels are available only in a paid option, which cannot be converted into a portable IPTVX URL without credentials/DRM.

Samira+'s official listing still advertises international 24/7 HD live viewing, but the official website returned HTTP 500 and exposed no portable public HLS. The app/account service remains a recovery path, not a publishable M3U source.

The exact El Watania first-party 1080p HLS failed three new independent attempts: one reprobe failure and two no-response failures. It remains recorded but unpublished because it would stall on Apple TV.
The exact official TV6, TV8, TV9, and El Hayat YouTube handles were all checked again and none was live. Echorouk News still exposed only an upcoming event that had not begun.
Kantar Africascope 2025 ranks Samira TV and Echorouk TV first and second among channels watched in Algeria; El Heddaf TV, Ennahar TV, and ENTV Programme National also appear in its current top ten.

Télédiffusion d’Algérie's current official satellite roster confirms Samira TV, Echorouk TV, Echorouk News, El Hayat TV, and El Watania TV as carried Algerian services alongside the already-published private channels and the EPTV public bouquet.

Samira's official Samira+ app advertises international 24/7 HD live viewing, but the current public website exposes only app-store launch paths; no stable public non-DRM manifest suitable for IPTVX was available in this audit.

Echorouk's official live page generated a current signed Echorouk TV HLS URL, but three independent requests from the US terminated at the CDN without returning media. No geo-bypass was attempted and the channel remains unpublished.

Echorouk's separate official live-news page generated a fresh signed Echorouk News HLS URL, but three independent requests from the US likewise returned no media response. The only responsive alternative belonged to an unverified third-party distributor, so it was rejected despite returning HTTP 200.

TV6 failed two complete three-attempt public gates: timeout, TLS/no-response, malformed 0p video, and corrupt H.264/PPS evidence recurred. The former official HTA hostname also failed DNS resolution in seven parallel source probes, so TV6 was quarantined without deleting its target or source history.

El Watania's official website now embeds a first-party live player whose exact HLS endpoint decoded current 1920x1080 H.264/AAC video with the El Watania watermark and a current Algeria-time clock. It is not yet publishable: two complete three-attempt gates returned no-response or motion timeouts, and decoding 30 seconds of media took 88 seconds, which would visibly stall on Apple TV.

Samira+'s current official Google Play and App Store listings still advertise an international 24/7 HD live service, but the website exposes only account/app launch paths and the official Samira YouTube channel was not live during this run.

Echorouk TV and Echorouk News each failed a fresh three-attempt gate at the official CDN. Neither official YouTube channel had a playable live broadcast; Echorouk News exposed only an upcoming event that had not begun.

EPTV's current official site exposes YouTube identities for TV6, TV8, and TV9. All three exact official channels were checked and none was currently live; the previously failed TV6 HLS path remains quarantined.

No exact, current, publicly authorized non-DRM linear feed was found for El Hayat TV, TV8 Adhakira, or TV9 El Barlamaniya. Their official identities and search history remain in this registry rather than being discarded.

Almagharibia's direct cloud wrapper is refreshed every 20 minutes by GitHub Actions from the live identity exposed by the broadcaster's official app. The public relay now tries that wrapper first and independently races the official YouTube player resolver if the wrapper is rejected by its egress. The layered endpoint passed the complete public GitHub Actions playback gate and sustained changing video after a fresh IPTVX playlist reload.

EPTV's current official Android app, updated 2026-04-20, describes real-time news, articles, photos, and video rather than live linear channel delivery; it supplied no portable official TV6, TV8, or TV9 feed.
Fresh official live-handle checks found no active broadcast for TV6, TV8, TV9, or El Hayat. Echorouk News still exposed only an upcoming event that had not begun.

Samira+'s official website returned HTTP 500, while the current official Echorouk TV and Echorouk News player endpoints returned HTTP 403. No account token, private restream, or geo-bypass path was used.
El Watania's exact first-party HLS failed all three fresh independent attempts with no media response, so it remains a preserved recovery target rather than an Apple TV-visible dead entry.
The fresh research and the complete cloud regression found no newly viable exact channel; all 12 published channels remained healthy, TV6 remained quarantined, and no additional channel was removed.

Samira TV's main official website recovered from HTTP 500 to HTTP 200, but it exposes programme and registration content rather than a public live manifest. The official Samira+ app still advertises international 24/7 HD live service; its app site/API currently return HTTP 500 and the official CDN path exposed no authenticated or public portable HLS object.

EPTV's exact official TV6, TV8, and TV9 YouTube handles, El Hayat's official handle, Echorouk News, and El Watania were each checked again and none had an active exact live broadcast. The current iptv-org index exposed no legal exact candidate for any of the eight unpublished targets.
Echorouk TV and Echorouk News official player endpoints each returned HTTP 403 on three fresh attempts. No private restream, stolen token, or geo-bypass path was used.

El Watania's exact first-party 1080p H.264/AAC HLS transiently passed three quick probes, but every strict moving-media test returned no_response; three manifest GETs needed 10.6–11.2 seconds for only 262 bytes, and 15 seconds of requested decoding did not complete after two minutes. It remains unpublished because Apple TV would stall.

The complete public cloud regression found no failing published Algerian item. IPTVX showed all 12 expected identities after a forced cloud reload, and Almagharibia sustained visibly changing current video.

Fresh checks of the exact official TV6, TV8, TV9, Echorouk TV, Echorouk News, El Hayat, Samira TV, and El Watania YouTube identities found none currently live. Samira's official site, EPTV pages, Echorouk's official live page, and El Watania's site exposed no new portable public manifest.

The source formerly labelled TV6 resumed decoding at 1920x1080 H.264/AAC and passed three strict moving-media attempts, but two separated current frames visibly carried EPTV's El Dhakira watermark and exact TV8 programming. It was rejected as TV6 and the false route was removed.

The technically exact TV8 candidate passed three additional strict six-gate tests, five current-segment fetches, a 45-second content decode, two visibly different current frames, and a complete 39-attempt candidate-lineup gate. It was nevertheless withheld because the unaffiliated YCN distribution host supplied no evidence of EPTV authorization; exact identity and technical health do not override the legal-source gate.

Echorouk TV, Echorouk News, and the signed TV6 recovery path each returned cloud 5xx on three fresh probes. Current public indexes and maintained resolvers produced no other exact legally portable Algerian candidate.

An IPTVX regression exposed Almagharibia rendering one frame and then stalling even though conventional decoders passed. The relay was repaired by selecting a fixed 720p H.264/AAC rendition, parsing YouTube's path-based signature expiry correctly, and replacing oversized signed segment URLs with short Apple-compatible relay paths while removing nonstandard ad-cue tags.

The repaired Almagharibia endpoint passed three strict moving-media gates, a continuous 45-second public decode, and 20 seconds each of visibly changing current video in IPTVX preview and full-player modes. It remains published and no verified channel was lost.

The recovered feed previously labelled TV6 was visually proven to be exact TV8 El Dhakira and was never allowed to remain under the false TV6 identity. The exact TV8 source was also withdrawn after its unaffiliated distribution host could not establish broadcaster authorization; both targets and all evidence remain preserved for future official-source recovery.

Fresh checks of the exact official YouTube identities for TV6, TV8, TV9, Echorouk TV, Echorouk News, El Hayat, Samira TV, and El Watania found none currently live. TDA still confirms all eight target identities and carriage but exposes no portable IPTV manifest.

Echorouk's official page produced current signed exact Echorouk TV and Echorouk News HLS URLs. Both the direct six-attempt gate and a production-cloud relay test reached the authorized CDN but received empty/520 responses; dormant recovery routes were retained without publishing dead entries.

Samira+'s correct official support site is samira.plus, but it returned a current WAF/server 500 and no portable live manifest. El Watania's exact first-party HLS returned its tiny live index only after roughly 10.6 seconds and then stalled on expired/unavailable media, so neither qualified for Apple TV.

The Almagharibia GitHub wrapper expired while the shared French workflow held the previous common queue, and IPTVX correctly exposed the resulting intermittent black screen even though conventional probes happened to pass. The French and Algerian refresh workflows now use separate country-specific concurrency groups so one audit cannot delay the other's dynamic refresh.

Production relay version 32 hardened Almagharibia by rotating four official YouTube player endpoints and retrying through bounded independent cloud hops when one egress is challenged. The repaired route passed 30 of 30 concurrent cache-busted public manifest requests and then produced visibly different current Almagharibia frames 20 seconds apart in IPTVX; no Mac is involved.
latest_audit.result: No newly viable authorized exact channel qualified; the published lineup remains 12 of 20, with TV6 and the technically healthy but provenance-rejected TV8 preserved as separate recovery targets.
